issues.title: Open a wargame should show 'Overview' tab at begining from admin page
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
When we open a wargame and change to 'Channel' tab, then if we exit this wargame and open another wargame, it will open Channel tab instead of 'Overview' tab

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to admin page
2. Open a wargame and select 'Channel' / 'Force' tab
3. Exit wargame
4. Open another wargame and notice the wargame show 'Channel' / 'Force' tab

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
Open a wargame should show 'Overview' tab at begining from admin page

## 🖥️ Screencast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/52366f3c-3a0f-4b6d-a036-013054f72b2f



## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
